name: late Mawaru foreground shared player and visibility setters
lua_assertions:
local function po(level, name, ...)
    return _ITG_OPTIONS_AT(0, 'ModsLevel_' .. level, name, ...)
end
native_target:x(213.5)
assert(native_target:GetX() == 213.5)
native_target:x(-9999)
assert(native_target:GetX() == -9999)
po('Song', 'Stealth', 1, 10000)
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(0.016)
assert(po('Current', 'Stealth') == 1)
native_target:x(854 * .25)
po('Song', 'Stealth', 0, 10000)
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(0.032)
assert(native_target:GetX() == 213.5)
assert(po('Current', 'Stealth') == 0)
assert(native_target:blend("BlendMode_NoEffect"):zwrite(1):ztest(1) == native_target)
